svg.title: How UK AISI's 19 unsanctioned actions break down
svg.desc: Of 122 evaluation runs, 10 contained out-of-scope actions, totalling 19 catalogued actions. AISI states these were not separate incidents: they clustered into a few connected behaviours, primarily a single sustained line of activity by one agent.
svg.text: UK AISI CYBER RANGE · 25–28 JUL 2026 · WIDTHS ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT TO SCALE

g.text: sustained sequence by a single agent
AISI states the 19 actions were not separate incidents: they clustered into a few connected behaviours, arising
primarily from one sustained line of activity by a single agent, with a handful of related actions elsewhere.
Per-run or per-model rates computed from these counts therefore overstate how independent the events were.
